content:
maria: Heads up — product wants an 'isolation + insight' pane in Console for customers. Need runtime/infra inputs for 3 panels: routing breakdown, quota burn, and a noisy-process heatmap. Can teams align on fields?

ashok: We can emit routing.stats.{success,fallback,latency_p50,latency_p95} keyed by org. Need to agree on tag: org_id (uuid) vs org_slug. I prefer org_id for stability.

samir: Runtime is +1 for org_id. We can also add cache.hit_rate and kv.cache_age. Heads up: these will increase metric cardinality and cost.

eva: UX ask: panes should support a per-customer view and a grouped view (account clusters). Also need a toggle to hide noisy neighbors. How will noisy detection surface?

jordan: Noisy neighbor plan (draft): noisy.score = norm(qps) * p95_latency_increase + kv_miss_spike_factor. We'll emit noisy.score (0-100) and noisy.reason tags (e.g., "spike-kv-miss"). Rule: score > 60 -> flagged.

rachel: Quick security check: org_id is internal, ok. But if we show it in Console for customers, we should mask IDs and only show customer display names when allowed.

ashok: Agreed — telemetry should send org_id but Console will map to display name via auth lookup. For quota: emit quota.{limit,used,window_seconds,window_start_ts} per-route so Console can compute burn rate.

maria: Timeline: product wants a canary in a single customer account next week. Can runtime/infra push schema today so Console can wire up mock data?

samir: I'll push a schema delta to metrics-collector tomorrow AM. Example payload we'll emit:

```
{
  "org_id": "org-123",
  "routing": {"success": 980, "fallback": 20, "latency_p95": 320},
  "cache": {"hit_rate": 0.72},
  "noisy": {"score": 72, "reason": "spike-kv-miss"}
}
```

eva: Console needs explicit metadata: name, type, unit, aggregation for each metric so editors can render correctly. e.g. metric_unit: 'ms' or 'ratio', aggregation: 'p95'/'avg'.

samir: I'll add a metric_metadata array to the schema so we can extend without breaking parsers.

jordan: Rollout UX suggestion: start read-only with sample dashboard. Add an opt-in toggle to include 'noisy neighbors' in the aggregate. If noisy.score present, show a :warning: pill with the reason and a link to the runbook.

maria: Also product wants a retention flag for saved exports (30 days default). Can we include retention_days?

rachel: Legal: 30 days is OK for metrics. But keep it metrics-only — no raw prompt text or user content stored. If any PII shows up, fallback to 7-day default and mask.

samir: Confirmed — metrics only, no raw prompts or user-level content in this telemetry.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary push: metrics-collector schema v2.3 -> 2024-07-03T12:00:00Z

maria: Action items:
- samir: push schema delta + metric_metadata (due tomorrow AM)
- ashok: update runtime routing emit + quota fields (due EOD)
- eva: mockups for new pane + noisy-pill (48h)
- rachel: finalize exposure policy doc by EOD
We'll reconvene when schema is live. :thumbsup:
